title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Riverside Orthopedic Associates under your health plan for services provided on July 15, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
We could not process this claim because of a billing error: the procedure code does not match the place of service reported by the provider. Reason code: CO-16.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $402.54 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $402.54.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 60 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Ostrander Mutual Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 73305, Springfield, IL 62701. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-4745.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
